Karim's Giant Roosterfish Battle in San José del Cabo

Fishing Report Jul 17 Written by EXOTIC FISH-CABO

An Unforgettable Giant Roosterfish Battle in San José del Cabo

July 2026 brought an extraordinary fishing experience for Karim, an angler visiting from Montreal, Canada.

Joining Exotic Fish Cabo for a private fishing adventure departing from Puerto Los Cabos Marina, Karim headed out early in the morning to explore the coastal waters of San José del Cabo.

The sea was calm, the morning sun was rising, and conditions were ideal for an exciting day on the water.

But Karim was about to experience something truly special.

A Spectacular Roosterfish Strike

As the crew slowly trolled a live mullet behind the boat, the surface suddenly exploded.

An enormous roosterfish attacked the bait with incredible force, sending water spraying in every direction.

The fish immediately dove deep, pulling line from the reel as Karim prepared for a demanding battle.

Roosterfish are famous for their aggressive strikes, powerful runs, and distinctive comb-like dorsal fins.

This impressive fish demonstrated exactly why anglers travel to Los Cabos hoping to encounter one.

A Battle of Strength and Determination

Karim held firmly onto the rod as the roosterfish made powerful runs, repeatedly testing his strength and patience.

Every time the fish appeared to slow down, another burst of energy sent it pulling away from the boat.

With concentration, determination, and assistance from the crew, Karim continued working the fish closer.

The battle required patience and careful line management.

Finally, after a long and exciting fight, Karim brought the giant roosterfish alongside the boat.

Its brilliant silver body and magnificent dorsal fin made for an unforgettable sight.

The excitement aboard was immediate.

For Karim, this was much more than an ordinary fishing trip. It was a remarkable encounter with one of Baja California Sur's most iconic coastal game fish.

Sometimes, the most memorable fishing experiences aren't about the number of fish caught. They're about the excitement of the strike, the challenge of the fight, and the satisfaction of achieving something extraordinary.

For Karim, this July morning became a fishing adventure worth remembering.

Trip Highlights

  • Date: July 2026

  • Departure: Puerto Los Cabos Marina, San José del Cabo

  • Angler: Karim, visiting from Montreal, Canada

  • Species caught: Roosterfish (Nematistius pectoralis)

  • Bait used: Live mullet

  • Fishing technique: Slow trolling

  • Catch highlight: A giant roosterfish brought alongside the boat

  • Fishing conditions: Calm seas and early morning sunshine

  • Experience: Private coastal fishing charter

Why Roosterfish Fishing Is So Exciting in Los Cabos

Roosterfish are among the most sought-after inshore game fish in Baja California Sur.

Recognized by their spectacular comb-like dorsal fins, these powerful predators are known for aggressive surface strikes, strong runs, and determined fighting ability.

Live mullet can be an effective bait when roosterfish are actively feeding along the coastline.

During the summer months, coastal waters around San José del Cabo can offer exciting opportunities to encounter larger roosterfish, depending on bait availability and ocean conditions.

Patience, proper fishing techniques, and experienced crew assistance can make a significant difference when battling these powerful fish.

Every fishing trip is different. Weather, ocean currents, water temperature, and seasonal fish activity all influence fishing opportunities.

Catches are never guaranteed.
